name: New Order
lyricQuotes: How does it feel / To treat me like you do
Every time I see you falling / I get down on my knees and pray

shortBio.en: Manchester, 1980–. Sumner, Hook, Morris, plus Gillian Gilbert on keys. Blue Monday and Power, Corruption & Lies are core references.
shortBio.zh: 曼彻斯特，1980 年至今。Sumner、Hook、Morris，加 Gillian Gilbert 键盘。《Blue Monday》与《Power, Corruption & Lies》是主要参照。

body.en: Formed 1980 from Joy Division after Ian Curtis’s death: Sumner, Hook, Morris, plus Gillian Gilbert on keys. Factory Records, Peter Saville sleeves, and the Hacienda club framed the 1980s. Blue Monday became the best-selling UK 12-inch. Electronic (Sumner with Johnny Marr of The Smiths) and other side projects ran beside the albums.
body.zh: 1980 年由 Joy Division 在 Ian Curtis 去世后重组：Sumner、Hook、Morris，加上键盘手 Gillian Gilbert。Factory、Peter Saville 封面与 Hacienda 俱乐部构成 1980 年代背景。《Blue Monday》成为英国史上最畅销的 12 英寸单曲。Sumner 与 The Smiths 的 Johnny Marr 的 Electronic 等分支与专辑并行。

whyMatters.en: Manchester band formed in 1980 from Joy Division’s remaining members, plus Gillian Gilbert. From Movement (1981) through Technique (1989): sequencers, drum machines, and Hook’s high bass over Sumner’s dry vocal.
whyMatters.zh: 曼彻斯特乐队，1980 年由 Joy Division 余部成立，并加入 Gillian Gilbert。自《Movement》（1981）到《Technique》（1989）：音序器、鼓机，以及 Hook 高音贝斯叠 Sumner 干人声。

note.en: Curtis lyric with new music; early New Order single continuity from Joy Division.
note.zh: Curtis 歌词配新曲；New Order 早期单曲，承接 Joy Division。

note.en: Oberheim DMX and sequenced bass; major 12-inch seller.
note.zh: Oberheim DMX 与音序低音；重要的 12 寸畅销单曲。

note.en: 1987 single; dry Sumner vocal over programmed groove; linked to the Technique period.
note.zh: 1987 单曲；干 Sumner 人声叠程序化律动；属 Technique 时期周边。

title.en: From Joy Division to New Order
title.zh: 从 Joy Division 到 New Order

body.en: Bass often carries the melody instead of only the root. Blue Monday (1983) set a 12-inch sales mark in the UK and sits beside Joy Division’s Love Will Tear Us Apart as the catalog’s twin landmarks.
body.zh: 贝斯常负责旋律而不只是根音。《Blue Monday》（1983）刷新英国 12 英寸销量纪录，与 Joy Division 的《Love Will Tear Us Apart》并列成为曲库两座坐标。

title.zh: Blue Monday 与 1980 年代中期专辑

body.en:
Blue Monday (1983) uses Oberheim DMX and sequenced bass. The Factory die-cut sleeve cost more than early single revenue.

Power, Corruption & Lies includes Age of Consent and The Village—synth pads with Hook bass hooks. Low-Life (1985) and Brotherhood refine the electronic and post-punk mix for college radio.
body.zh:
《Blue Monday》（1983）使用 Oberheim DMX 与音序低音。Factory 模切封套成本一度高于早期单曲收入。

《Power, Corruption & Lies》含《Age of Consent》与《The Village》——合成器铺底与 Hook 贝斯钩子。Low-Life（1985）与 Brotherhood 把电子与后朋克混合写得更适合 college radio。

body.en: Cross-band threads in the book: Marr/Smiths via Electronic; Pet Shop Boys; Kraftwerk’s Bartos; Smashing Pumpkins’ Corgan on the Get Ready return; comparison to The Doors’ post-Morrison doubt at the Joy Division → New Order handoff.
body.zh: 书中的跨乐队线索：经 Electronic 连到 Marr／Smiths；Pet Shop Boys；Kraftwerk 的 Bartos；《Get Ready》回归时的 Billy Corgan；Joy Division → New Order 交接处对标 The Doors 在 Morrison 之后的不确定。

body.en: Joy Division-era lyric with new arrangement; Sumner sings. Early Factory single that links the two band names.
body.zh: Joy Division 时期歌词配新编曲；Sumner 演唱。早期 Factory 单曲，连接两个乐队名。

body.en: Oberheim DMX, sequenced bass, Sumner vocal. Best-known club-facing track from the catalog.
body.zh: Oberheim DMX、音序低音、Sumner 人声。目录中最知名的面向俱乐部曲目。

body.en: 1987 single with programmed groove and dry Sumner vocal. Sits with the late-1980s synth-pop side of the catalog.
body.zh: 1987 单曲；程序化律动与干 Sumner 人声。属目录中 1980 年代末 synth-pop 一面。

interviewQuotes.text: After Joy Division we had to dance or die.
interviewQuotes.speaker: Bernard Sumner

interviewQuotes.text: Blue Monday was a machine we barely understood—and it worked.
interviewQuotes.speaker: Stephen Morris

note.en: Movement (1981) then Temptation / Blue Monday. Power, Corruption & Lies through Technique. Hook → Revenge; Gilbert/Morris → The Other Two; Sumner + Marr → Electronic (also worked with Pet Shop Boys and Kraftwerk’s Karl Bartos).
note.zh: 《Movement》（1981）之后是《Temptation》《Blue Monday》。《Power, Corruption & Lies》到《Technique》。Hook → Revenge；Gilbert/Morris → The Other Two；Sumner + Marr → Electronic（并与 Pet Shop Boys、Kraftwerk 的 Karl Bartos 合作）。

note.en: Phil Cunningham (ex-Marion) replaced Gilbert for Get Ready-era work with Billy Corgan’s support; Hook left; 2011 return without Hook, Gilbert back, Chapman on bass.
note.zh: Phil Cunningham（前 Marion）在《Get Ready》时期接替 Gilbert，录音与巡演有 Billy Corgan 支持；Hook 离开；2011 年 Hook 缺席回归，Gilbert 回来，Chapman 弹贝斯。

note.en: Sequencer and Hook bass; major club 12-inch from the catalog.
note.zh: 音序器与 Hook 贝斯；目录中重要的俱乐部 12 寸。

note.en: Post–Joy Division players with drum machines and sequencers.
note.zh: Joy Division 之后的乐手编制，加上鼓机与音序器。
